title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is a working page (Grothendieck's own numbering p. 536) in the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets' section of the Longue Marche follow-up. The notation suggests the setting is algebraic-group models attached to the two elliptic elements ρ (order 3) and σ (order 2) of the modular group: G a GL2-type group, SG its special (determinant-1) part, T_ρ and T_σ tori, N'_σ a torus normaliser.

On the previous page he fixed a torus T_0 contained in a Borel of SG. He set B'_0 = T_0·L_0, a semidirect product with L_0 normalised by T_0. He then enlarged the group M_{ρ,σ}(0) (dimension 3) to M_{ρ,σ}[0] := Θ^{-1}(B'_0) (dimension 4). There M[0] ∩ SG-part = B'_0 ∩ SG, L_0 is normal in M[0], and (16) M[0] = M(0)·L_0 as a semidirect product.

This page continues as follows.
- (i) L_0 is invariant under T_0.
- (ii) M[0] acts on SG through Θ|M[0] : M[0] → B'_0 ⊂ SG, by inner automorphisms.
- (iii) (17) defines the semidirect product SM_{ρ,σ} := M[0] ⋉ SG. A marginal note says this is to be made more or less definitive at p. 538, (19). In SM_{ρ,σ}, SG is normal and M[0] is a subgroup.
- (iv) (18): since M(0) ⊂ M[0], one gets an inclusion M(0) ⋉ SG ⊂ M[0] ⋉ SG. The left side is identified with the previously defined group M_{ρ,σ}, the right side is SM_{ρ,σ}. So M_{ρ,σ} becomes a subgroup of SM_{ρ,σ}.
- (v) A struck-out sentence had claimed that L_0 acts trivially on SG via Θ.
- (vi) Grothendieck then says he is again getting lost. He cannot connect the 'geometric' meaning of the comparison between SM_{ρ,σ} and M[0] with the notations of p. 529, and notes this needs to be made explicit.

The next page proceeds instead with a different, more intrinsic description. M_{ρ,σ} embeds in G × T_ρ × N'_σ × G_m × μ_2 via (Θ_G, Θ_ρ, Θ_σ, χ, ε). It is cut out by determinant-compatibility equations δ_G(U) = δ_σ(b), (δ_ρ(a)/δ_σ(b))^2 = 1. That looks like the route he took after the confusion recorded here.

Purpose: build a convenient algebraic-group model for the symmetry group M_{ρ,σ} of the configuration (ρ, σ). It serves computations ('pré-calculs') related to the loop equation, presumably for Galois–Teichmüller / GT-type actions in low dimension.
errors: The struck-out claim that L_0 acts trivially on SG via Θ|M[0] is wrong as stated. Θ maps M[0] onto B'_0 ⊃ L_0, which acts on SG by non-trivial inner automorphisms. Grothendieck correctly deleted it.
The inclusion (18) needs the action of M(0) on SG used to define M_{ρ,σ} to coincide with the restriction of the M[0]-action via Θ. This is implicit, not checked on the page.
The page ends in self-declared confusion about the geometric meaning, so the construction is left unjustified here. It is superseded by the embedding (19)-(22) on the next page.

ideas.what: Enlarging a 3-dimensional group M(0) to a 4-dimensional group M[0] = Θ^{-1}(B'_0) and forming the semidirect product M[0] ⋉ SG through a homomorphism to a Borel-type subgroup acting by inner automorphisms
ideas.modern_name: semidirect product via inner action / pullback of a Borel subgroup

ideas.what: Realising M_{ρ,σ} = M(0) ⋉ SG as a subgroup of SM_{ρ,σ} = M[0] ⋉ SG
ideas.modern_name: functoriality of semidirect products in the acting group

deep.surprise_reason: The page is routine bookkeeping of semidirect products of algebraic groups in an exploratory computation. It is partly struck out, and the author admits being lost. No new result or connection appears beyond the general context of the loop-equation notes.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'invarié par T_0' should read 'invariant par T_0'.
'opérant par automorphismes[?] comme on a vu ip[?]' is more likely 'opérant par automorphismes intérieurs (i.e.) Θ|M_{ρ,σ}[0] : M_{ρ,σ}[0] → B'_0'.
The marginal note along (17) reads roughly 'plus ou moins définitivement[?], cf p. 538, (19)'. It is a margin annotation, not an insertion in the formula.

Last paragraph: the struck word before 'Je commence' looks like 'Rassemblant' or similar rather than 'Remarque'. A plausible reading is 'Je commence à nouveau à m'y perdre, je vois mal raccorder — pour me rendre[?] la signification "géométrique" de la comparaison entre SM_{ρ,σ}, M_{ρ,σ}[0] aux notations de la p. 529, qui mérite d'être explicitée par moi[?]'.
